artworks.title: The Madonna and Child Enthroned with a Bishop Saint and a Kneeling Ecclesiastic
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a religious scene. In the center is a figure seated on a throne or elevated chair, with a halo around their head. Another smaller figure is seated on their knee. To the left stands a figure in a robe with a pointed hat and staff. To the right, another figure bends forward. Below the central figure, two cherubic figures are depicted. The drawing is done in a monochrome palette of browns and sepia tones with delicate shading. A rectangular border frames the scene.

artworks.title: Jupiter Defeating the Giants
artworks.artist: attributed to Girolamo Faccioli, after Perino del Vaga
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring two main sections. The upper section shows a group of figures surrounded by clouds in a celestial realm. A bearded figure sits centrally, with other figures gesturing around him. The lower section depicts figures in varied poses on rocky terrain, expressing turmoil or despair. The drawing is detailed and includes intricate shading, focusing on the physiques, drapery, and landscape.

artworks.title: The Kingfisher's Haunt
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache on paper laid down on board
artworks.description: The painting depicts a rocky stream flowing over reddish-brown stones. The horizon is not visible in the scene. The stream narrows and curves beyond the rocks. The water cascades gently over smooth stones towards us, with a frothy texture. The color palette includes deep browns, greens, and a splash of blue from a bird. Greenery covers the upper areas as branches stretch overhead against a russet backdrop.

artworks.title: Study of Bay Leaves
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a branch with elongated leaves in muted greens and grays. The branch is positioned diagonally from the bottom right to the top left of the image, with leaves overlapping and creating a layered effect. The initials "H.R." are inscribed in the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: La Galerie du Palais
artworks.description: This is a detailed interior scene in a gallery. The artwork features elegantly dressed figures engaging in various activities. The room is lined with shelves filled with books and goods. A dog and a small monkey can be seen in the foreground. Above the shelves are names resembling European goods or establishments. The intricate costumes and architectural detailing suggest a setting from the 17th century.

artworks.title: A Study of Leaves
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Diana and Mallory Walker, Alfred H. Moses and Fern M. Schad Fund, and W. Bruce and Delaney H. Lundberg
artworks.description: The image shows an arrangement of various leaves. The color palette is monochromatic, consisting of sepia tones that range from light beige to dark brown. The leaves are laid out concentrically, with some pointing upwards and outwards near the top and others more spread out horizontally across the middle and lower sections. A few smaller leaves fill in gaps between the larger ones.

artworks.title: The Coming Storm: A Fishing Boat Making for Home off Whitby
artworks.medium: watercolor over traces of graphite with scratching out
artworks.description: The image depicts a maritime scene with several ships sailing on a vast ocean expanse. The horizon is above the midpoint, and the waves are shown with swirling brushstrokes. The color palette consists of greys and blues, with hints of white in the waves. Seagulls are seen in the sky.

artworks.title: Path in the Countryside, Vichy
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash, on wove(?) paper laid down on an old mount
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Joan and David Maxwell in Honor of Margaret Morgan Grasselli

artworks.title: The Heather or Broom Gatherers
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Alexander M. and Judith W. Laughlin
artworks.description: The image displays a pastoral scene with a panoramic view of the landscape. The horizon appears in the upper third of the painting with small distant figures and livestock. The brushstrokes are loose and fluid, depicting movement and texture, notably in the clouds. The sky shows varied shades of blue and white against the earthy tones of the land. In the foreground, people load lavender-colored flowers onto donkeys amidst greenery and blossoms. The color palette blends cool blues and purples with warm earth tones harmoniously.

artworks.title: Pusterla dei Fabbri, Milan
artworks.medium: charcoal with stumping, wash, graphite, and pen and black ink, heightened with white gouache
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a narrow street with tall buildings on both sides. There is a distant archway on the right, creating depth. The sketch features figures in period attire, a carriage drawn by two horses, and a busy street scene. The drawing uses soft pencil or charcoal strokes with shading and a grayscale color palette with subtle tonal variations. The background is less detailed, focusing on the central scene.

artworks.title: Sintesi di figura seduta (Synthesis of a Seated Figure)
artworks.medium: etching and softground etching, printed in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person sitting, depicted in a sketchy, textured style that emphasizes shadows and lines. The person's face is partially turned to the right and slightly tilted downward. Their facial features are suggested through bold lines, with closed or downcast eyes and a neutral mouth. The hair is styled back with defined strokes. The person is wrapped in a coat or cloak, with shading and cross-hatching creating depth. The background features textured cross-hatching, providing a sense of confined space with no discernible objects or detailed scenery, keeping the focus on the person.

artworks.title: Sleeping Shepherd Tickled by a Shepherdess
artworks.artist: Giuseppe Maria Crespi and Ludovico Mattioli
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 23.9 × 17.9 cm (9 7/16 × 7 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a pastoral scene with a landscape, sheep grazing on a hillside, a resting figure, and another standing figure interacting with the first. The scene includes rolling hills, a leafy tree, cumulus clouds in the sky, and intricate linework defining textures and shapes. The drawing uses shading and hatching to suggest form and depth, creating a detailed black and white image.

artworks.title: Design for an Altar
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over traces of black chalk with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ann and Matthew Nimetz
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an elaborate architectural doorway or niche. The drawing shows a highly detailed and ornate doorway or niche structure with classical architectural elements. A large arch spans the top, decorated with intricate patterns and a central emblem depicting a face or figure. Below the arch, a triangular pediment is supported by fluted columns, with elaborately carved capitals. The space within the columns seems intended as a niche. Along the sides and inside the arch are detailed moldings, reliefs, and smaller decorative elements, such as cherubs or putti sitting on each side of the pediment. Flourishes and ornamental carvings enhance the overall grandeur of the structure. The drawing style is precise with fine lines, emphasizing the craftsmanship and symmetry typical of neoclassical or baroque architecture.

artworks.title: Portrait of Count Giacomo Durazzo
artworks.artist: Giovanni David, Giovanni Vitalba, and Bartolommeo Benincasa (author)
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, and engraving on laid paper tipped into book as frontispiece
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within platemark at right where sheet is tipped into book): 29.4 × 21.2 cm (11 9/16 × 8 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait showing the head and upper torso of a man in profile, in an oval frame adorned with decorative elements like ribbons and foliage. The man is positioned to the right side, displaying a side profile. His facial features exhibit a high forehead, prominent nose, and closed lips. His hair is neatly styled, likely a wig of the period, tied at the back with a ribbon. He is wearing formal attire, consisting of a jacket and a ruffled cravat. In the area surrounding the portrait, there are artistic elements such as papers, an inkwell with a pen, and a painter's palette and brushes. The background comprises a rectangular frame with detailed decorative carvings.

artworks.title: Saint Catherine of Siena on a Cloud
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white chalk on blue laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Robert B. Loper and Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a figure in a reclined position with open arms, facing upwards. The head is tilted back, and the face is in a three-quarter view with a calm expression. The person's hair is covered by a draped scarf, and the clothing is flowing with deep folds. The figure appears to be sitting on a soft surface, and the drawing is done with light lines on a textured surface. The background is plain, and there are no visible jewelry or objects.

artworks.title: The Last Supper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.1 × 4.4 cm (2 3/8 × 1 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate gathering scene. The detailed etching features a group of figures seated around a central figure, surrounded by elaborate architectural elements such as intricately carved columns and archways. The figures are depicted with halos and arranged closely together, engaged in an event. The scene is framed by an ornate border with decorative patterns and putti at the top. The style is reminiscent of Renaissance-era engravings with detailed linework and shading.

artworks.title: The Flagellation
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.3 × 4.2 cm (2 1/2 × 1 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing with multiple figures in an intense scene. There is a central architectural structure with columns and textiles. The scene shows a figure kneeling with a halo, surrounded by other figures engaged in dynamic actions. Above, there is an alcove with two putti. The drawing is detailed with rich texture created by lines and cross-hatching, providing depth to the figures and architecture. The border is decorated with vines or floral motifs.

artworks.title: The Betrayal of Christ
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.3 × 4.6 cm (2 1/2 × 1 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of armed figures within a decorative frame. The detailed scene depicts individuals clustered tightly together. Some are holding weapons or shields. The central figure is depicted with a halo. The action is surrounded by an intricately designed border with ornate motifs and cherubic figures in the top corners. The style of the drawing is reminiscent of medieval or early Renaissance woodcuts, with fine lines and shading creating depth and texture.

artworks.title: Christ on the Mount of Olives
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.3 × 4.6 cm (2 1/2 × 1 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene within a decorative frame. The central image shows a group of figures in action. The background includes a mountain landscape with clouds. In the foreground, a figure is kneeling in prayer, surrounded by others. The artwork is enclosed by an ornate frame with floral and cherubic motifs, resembling a woodcut or engraving with intricate line work.

artworks.title: Christ Carrying the Cross and Saint Veronica
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.3 × 4.3 cm (2 1/2 × 1 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a framed scene filled with human figures and decorative elements. The drawing depicts a highly detailed and intricate scene bordered by an ornate frame. The frame includes classical architectural elements and cherubic figures at the top corners holding instruments. Within the frame, the scene is densely populated with dynamic movement and interaction among the figures. The landscape within the frame contains bare trees and a cliff-like structure, adding depth to the scene. The image is rich in texture, indicative of a traditional printmaking technique. The drawing suggests a narrative scene from classical or religious mythology, shown with a strongly etched style.

artworks.title: The Resurrection
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.2 × 4.3 cm (2 7/16 × 1 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a religious scene with figures and architectural elements. The central figure stands on a platform with a halo, holding a scepter or cross, draped in a robe and surrounded by clouds. Below the figure are two soldiers in armor with shields. The drawing is enclosed in an ornate architectural frame with decorative elements and cherubic figures in the corners. The lines are detailed, showcasing intricate designs, common in religious art from the Renaissance period.

artworks.title: Ecce Homo
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.4 × 4.3 cm (2 1/2 × 1 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ancient architectural scene with figures in an ornate architectural setting. The image depicts a detailed environment that includes a group of figures gathered within, surrounded by arches, columns, and a decorative border. The scene is portrayed through a stylized style, with carvings and embellishments in the framing architecture, including floral and geometric patterns. The central figure is prominently placed on an elevated platform. The drawing's use of linework and shading techniques creates a sense of depth and complexity.

artworks.title: Pilate Washing his Hands
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.4 × 4.4 cm (2 1/2 × 1 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures engaged in an indoor scene. The central part shows figures engaged in various activities within a detailed interior with columns and arches in the background. The borders are decorated with floral motifs and cherubic figures. The style is reminiscent of intricate engravings from the Renaissance period.

artworks.title: Christ Nailed to the Cross
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.3 × 4.4 cm (2 1/2 × 1 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene. The drawing shows a narrative scene with numerous figures gathered around a central figure lying prostrate in the lower part of the image. The central figure wears a halo and is surrounded by individuals offering aid or observing. Some onlookers have varying expressions. The scene is framed by ornate borders with floral and scroll motifs. At the top, two cherubic figures in clouds can be seen. The composition is complex with intricate lines emphasizing expressions and drapery, suggesting a narrative of importance.
